title: Repair Bench Rate Schedule for CalCare Tool Repair & Calibration Plan Tiers
content:
Repairs of instruments under the CalCare Tool Repair & Calibration Plan are priced and warranted by tier. The schedule below gives, for every tier, the labor rate, the parts discount, the estimate above which a written quote is required, how long a quote stays open, the repair warranty, and the fees for an instrument found beyond economical repair and for its disposal.

| Tier | Labor rate (USD per hour) | Parts discount off list price (percent) | Written quote required above (USD) | Quote open for decision (calendar days) | Repair warranty (days) | Beyond-repair evaluation fee (USD) | Disposal fee (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| CalCare Pay-Per-Service | 115.00 | 0 | 150.00 | 15 | 90 | 45.00 | 20.00 |
| CalCare Basic Plan | 110.00 | 5 | 150.00 | 15 | 90 | 45.00 | 20.00 |
| CalCare Standard Plan | 105.00 | 10 | 250.00 | 30 | 90 | 35.00 | 15.00 |
| CalCare Accredited Plan | 100.00 | 10 | 250.00 | 30 | 180 | 35.00 | 15.00 |
| CalCare Onsite Plan | 95.00 | 15 | 500.00 | 30 | 180 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| CalCare Enterprise Plan | 90.00 | 20 | 750.00 | 45 | 365 | 0.00 | 0.00 |

### Schedule terms

1. Labor rate: repair labor rate, USD per hour.
2. Parts discount: discount on repair parts list price, percent.
3. Quote threshold: repair estimate, USD, above which the customer must approve a written quote before repair.
4. Quote validity: calendar days a repair quote stays open for the customer's decision.
5. Repair warranty: days a completed repair is warranted.
6. Beyond-repair evaluation fee: evaluation fee when an instrument is found beyond economical repair, USD.
7. Disposal fee: fee to dispose of a beyond-repair instrument at the customer's request, USD.

### Tier comparisons

- The quote threshold is 150.00 on CalCare Pay-Per-Service and CalCare Basic Plan, 250.00 on CalCare Standard Plan and CalCare Accredited Plan, 500.00 on CalCare Onsite Plan and 750.00 on CalCare Enterprise Plan.
- A quote stays open 15 calendar days on the first two tiers, 30 on the middle three and 45 on CalCare Enterprise Plan.
- The repair warranty is 90 days on the first three tiers, 180 days on CalCare Accredited Plan and CalCare Onsite Plan, and 365 days on CalCare Enterprise Plan.
- CalCare Onsite Plan and CalCare Enterprise Plan charge 0.00 for both the beyond-repair evaluation and disposal.

### Hypothetical lookup

On the CalCare Standard Plan, a part listing at 100.00 is billed at 10 percent off list, that is 90.00, and labor is billed at 105.00 per hour.
